resources.string: This permanently deletes your TexPro ERP Google sign-in and the cloud profile stored for your user ID. Local mill ledgers on this device are not erased. If Google requires recent sign-in, you will be asked to sign in again first.

TexPro ERP is a textile manufacturing accounting app for mill operators.

Data we process
• Local ledgers: sale orders, lots, vouchers, chart of accounts, and organization profiles are stored on this device in an encrypted-at-rest Android database.
• Account data (only if you tap Sign in with Google): Google account identifier, email address, and display name.
• Optional Google Drive: when you choose Save to Drive, the active mill ledger is written to a folder you own (TexPro ERP / organization name) as texpro-ledger.json. Load Drive reads that file back onto this device.
• Optional Firebase: if google-services.json is installed, sign-in may also create a Firebase Auth user and Firestore copy of the tenant.

What we do not do
• We do not show ads, sell personal data, or use your mill data for advertising.
• We do not collect contacts, photos, location, SMS, or microphone data.
• Automatic cloud backup of the ledger is disabled unless you tap Save to Drive or Sync Firestore.

Retention and deletion
• Local data remains until you uninstall the app or clear app storage.
• Drive files remain in your Google account until you delete them in Drive.
• Signed-in users can clear the Google session from SaaS Organization Manager → Cloud & Account.

Contact
Use the support email listed on the Google Play store listing for privacy requests.
